source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_documented.growth_habit: Annual herb 15–50 cm tall (annual from historical Valerianella genus)
morphology_documented.leaves: Simple, opposite, mostly sessile and sometimes clasping, entire or with few basal teeth (genus)
morphology_documented.flowers: Small terminal head-like cymes; corollas only 0.6–2 mm across under historical key
morphology_documented.fruit: Mature fruits broadly elliptic to nearly round; two sterile locules divergent, combined wider than fertile locule (historical key); mature fruit required for separation

source_scope_note: Species vs. genus or key-level characters distinguished in each entry. No missing traits inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Historical Valerianaceae; Kew accepts name in Caprifoliaceae

Diggs notes V. woodsiana distinguishable from V. radiata primarily by fruit characters and taxon limits uncertain; Kew now puts Valerianella radiata under Valeriana woodsiana, so historical species separation must not be treated as a verified contemporary taxon distinction
preservation: Additive record; original species.json, media, credits and galleries unchanged
